meta.name: create-reviewer-agent
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "create a reviewer agent", "add a custom agent", "create a review agent", or "add a specialized reviewer". Create a custom reviewer agent with a specific model and tools.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需创建带指定模型和工具的审阅代理
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望在工作流中快速添加一个按需配置的审查代理。
copy.tagline_en: Create a custom reviewer agent with your chosen model and tools.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly add a customized review agent to your workflow.

howto.what: 当用户要求创建自定义评审代理时，Claude 会引导其指定名称、模型、描述、额外工具和技能等，生成代理定义文件并写入 .claude/agents/，然后告知如何在扩展中引用。
howto.when: 当用户说“create a reviewer agent”、“add a custom agent”、“create a review agent”等要求时触发。

say.text: 创建一个叫 security-reviewer 的评审代理
say.note: Claude 会询问模型、描述等并生成文件。

say.text: 加一个用 haiku 模型、专注速度的评审代理
say.note: 它会设置模型为 haiku 并写入对应定义。

say.text: 创建一个专门检查代码安全性的评审代理
say.note: 它会引导补充安全审查相关的指令和技能。

howto.what_en: When asked to create a custom reviewer agent, Claude walks the user through naming, model, description, extra tools/skills, writes the agent definition to .claude/agents/, and explains how to reference it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to 'create a reviewer agent', 'add a custom agent', 'create a review agent', etc.

say_en.text: Create a reviewer agent named security-reviewer
say_en.note: Claude will prompt for model, description, etc., then create the file.

say_en.text: Add a reviewer agent using haiku for speed
say_en.note: It sets the model to haiku and writes the definition.

say_en.text: Create a reviewer agent focused on code security
say_en.note: It guides you through adding security-related instructions and skills.
